purpose: Global RP Studio decision and execution method for SEO, organic search and SEO-directed content or media work. Client data, brand, history and visual systems remain site-scoped.

activation.rule: Apply when the task concerns SEO, organic search, search-performance evidence, organic content, or media directly supporting an SEO objective. Do not apply merely because a non-SEO task happens on a website.
signals: article or guide with an organic-search objective
image or media produced as part of SEO editorial work
non_signals: CSS bug fixing without an organic-search objective
purely promotional or social content without an organic-search objective

operating_rules: Understand the current site, entity and content before deciding what to change.
Retrieve the current site's site-scoped memory and relevant history when available.
Treat GSC, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog and other reports as evidence, never as automatic commands.
Use current research when a decision depends on the present state of the web, search results, competitors or SEO practice.
Analyze real search intent and relevant observable SERPs when pertinent.
Benchmark against the strongest relevant competitors and a top-tier international SEO/content agency standard appropriate to the case.

Check cannibalization, keyword-to-URL ownership, entity/topic coverage, content gaps, factual/source quality, internal linking, crawlability, indexability, canonical, schema, metadata, headings, images/ALT, user usefulness and business/commercial fit when pertinent.
Do not publish or modify something merely because an external tool flags an issue; choose the strongest intervention supported by the evidence.
Execute with existing RP Studio capabilities, then verify the real outcome.
Run the final quality gate. If the work is below the relevant benchmark, iterate instead of accepting the first solution.

quality_gate.guiding_question: Compared with the best relevant results observable today and a top-tier agency standard, is this solution genuinely competitive?

media_seo.rule: Derive the visual system from the current client/site. Never inherit another site's branding.
process: Analyze the content and SEO objective.
Retrieve the current site's brand and visual system from site-scoped memory when available.
If that memory is absent, analyze the current client/site rather than importing a global style.
Perform current visual research when pertinent and benchmark against strong contemporary references for the sector and format.
Create media coherent with the current client and verify realism, readability, relevance and quality.
Iterate when the media does not pass the quality gate.
media_seo.product_truth: Never invent brands, labels, vintages, packaging or product information when depicting a real product or a credible real-world category.

context_partition.invariant: Never promote site-specific information into the global policy.

tool_surface.rule: The policy is internal operating infrastructure and must not add, remove, hide or replace public MCP tools or capabilities.
